quotes.title: HD 118203
quotes.card: HD 118203 is a star with an orbiting exoplanet located in the northern circumpolar constellation of Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: It has the proper name Liesma, which means flame, and it is the name of a character from the Latvian poem Staburags un Liesma.
